info.author: GramAddict Team
info.name: GramAddict
info.summary: Completely free and open source human-like Instagram bot. Powered by UIAutomator2 and compatible with basically any android device that can run instagram - real or emulated.

vulnerabilities.details: GramAddict through 1.2.3 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code because of use of UIAutomator2 and ATX-Agent. The attacker must be able to reach TCP port 7912, e.g., by being on the same Wi-Fi network.
